title: Waaree Energies shares slide 6% despite 15% profit growth and 79% YoY revenue surge in Q1FY27 - The Economic Times
text:
Shares of Waaree Energies fell nearly 6% to Rs 2,581.70 despite posting a strong Q1FY27 performance. Consolidated net profit rose 15.39% YoY to Rs 891.87 crore, while revenue jumped 79.22% to Rs 7,931.79 crore. A record order book of Rs 61,500 crore continues to bolster future visibility.
